description_expanded: OverviewCOMPLETELY RENOVATED Gulf side condo, Private Beach, Pool, 2 Bikes `Sandprints`The SpaceWelcome to your new vacation destination! Sandprints is a fully remodeled, professionally designed condo is just what you and your family need for a fun filled getaway! Boasting 3 large bedrooms with private bathrooms, an open concept living and dining room and a HUGE outdoor patio - not to mention stunning gulf views for beautiful sunsets!Make your way past the pool into the front door and you will find the cozy living room with large flat screen TV, brand new furnishings, and plenty of seating. The kitchen with bar seating will have everything you need to cook your family a home cooked meal. Just past the kitchen is the back patio door that opens up to a large patio with dining table and plenty of shade!Head up the stairs and you will find the Master bedroom with King sized bed, flat screen TV and private bathrom. Also on this floor is a spacious guest bedroom with King sized bed, flat screen TV and private bathroom.One more flight of stairs will land you in the bunk room! With a full over a queen bunk bed, this room is large enough for a small family to share or for a few kids to spend the week! This room also includes a flat screen TV, private bathroom and large windows to grab a peek of that gulf view!We hope to see you soon!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Second Floor: Master Bedroom, King sized bed, private bathroomSecond Floor: Guest Bedroom, King sized bed, private bathroomThird Floor: Bunk Room, Full over Queen bed, private bathroomHOME HIGHLIGHTS:* Gulf Views* Fully remodeled unit* Community Pool right outside the door-no pool heat available* Wifi*Streaming only on all TV's* Steps to the private beach access* 2 Adult BikesAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back. Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
